steps: Create a new account, sign in, accept required legal acknowledgements.
expected_result: User reaches onboarding once; no route loop; legal state persists after refresh.
notes: Use a brand-new Firebase Auth user.

steps: Progress through Player Type, Wipe State, Blueprint Tracker and archetype steps with Next and Back.
expected_result: Active card scrolls fully into view, previous card loses highlight, electric highlight moves to the current action.

steps: Select multiple archetypes, leave the step, restart the app and return.
expected_result: All selected archetypes are saved and restored; profile completion uses the saved list.

steps: Finish onboarding with and without required profile fields.
expected_result: Complete Profile appears only while required profile fields are missing.
notes: Confirm Command Centre updates after save.

steps: Save availability and add a Favourite Rider.
expected_result: Availability and Favourite Rider data persist after restart and do not block Command Centre.
notes: Existing users must keep these values.

steps: Open the post-login home screen.
expected_result: Today's Mission, snapshot, top actions, alerts and trade opportunity answer what to do next without long scrolling.

steps: Tap each visible primary action and return with app/browser back.
expected_result: Each action opens the intended real screen or a safe empty state; no stale old My Hub home appears.

steps: Mark a blueprint owned, adjust duplicates, search, filter, jump and zoom.
expected_result: Ownership and duplicate state persist; protected grid rendering remains stable; no overflow.
notes: Do not edit canonical order during QA.

steps: Configure primary, secondary, slots, six Quick Use items and one augment, then save and restart.
expected_result: Images resolve, Hairpin path is correct, slot counts remain exact and stale attachments are removed.

steps: Track required resources, complete the current upgrade and restart.
expected_result: Progress record persists, next upgrade appears once, Operation event and reward fire once.
notes: Reset account should archive old-season state.

steps: Track a first quest, complete required items and restart.
expected_result: Quest progress persists, completed quest disappears from current priorities, next quest appears.

steps: Track one bench level, complete required resources and restart.
expected_result: Only that station advances; other benches remain unchanged; Command Centre recalculates.
notes: Include one Gunsmith and one non-Gunsmith case.

steps: Complete an Operation task, claim the reward, refresh and try again.
expected_result: Completion and claimed state persist; reward cannot be granted twice.

steps: Open Current, Previous and Permanent sections, equip badge, title, frame and banner, restart.
expected_result: Owned items remain unlocked, invalid historical cosmetics reconcile safely, equipped cosmetics persist.
notes: Profile and trading identity should update.

steps: Sign in with an existing seeded account.
expected_result: Profile, availability, Favourite Riders, reputation, trade reputation and progression remain intact.
notes: No accidental reset or false locked vault.

steps: Open reset preview, cancel, reopen, confirm and restart mid-flow if possible.
expected_result: Cancel leaves state unchanged; confirm applies once; same reset ID cannot duplicate.

steps: After reset, open Command Centre, Scrappy, quests, benches and Reward Vault.
expected_result: Old-season priorities disappear, new-season priorities appear, history remains available.

steps: Create, view, edit and cancel a listing.
expected_result: Listing state updates safely, deleted/expired records show safe empty states and no private inventory leaks.

steps: Make, accept, reject and withdraw offers; create and complete a trade session.
expected_result: Participants only see allowed records, ownership transfer is safe, notifications update.

steps: Create/join/leave/cancel a Match Rider session and restart.
expected_result: Profile readiness, compatibility explanation, availability overlap and favourite rider indicators persist.

steps: Open notification deep links, including one whose target has been deleted.
expected_result: Valid targets navigate correctly; deleted targets show a safe state with no raw Firebase error.

steps: Disable network, open Command Centre, trading, Reward Vault and tracker, then reconnect.
expected_result: Loading, offline, permission and retry states are user-safe and recover after reconnect.
notes: No raw Firebase exception should be visible.

steps: As admin, open diagnostics for a fresh, existing and reset user.
expected_result: Onboarding/profile, season/reset, progression, Operations, rewards, cosmetics and candidate reasons are visible read-only.
notes: Confirm non-admin cannot access admin-only surfaces.

steps: Repeat critical flows on Android portrait, Android landscape and desktop web.
expected_result: No overflow, clipped text, clipped banners, broken avatar frames or nested scroll traps.
